name: 次の日の献立 自動化
tagline: Today's meal photos in, tomorrow's balanced recipes back , linked
description: A Japanese-language meal planner working on a daily cycle. Photograph today's meals and send them over; it estimates the day's calories, notes which nutrients fell short, then answers with breakfast, lunch and dinner ideas for tomorrow pulled from real recipe posts on X, screenshots included.
author: fukubae_kenko_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
